methods.name: E-values of hazard ratios with a common outcome
methods.reference: EValue::evalues.HR(est, lo, hi, rare = FALSE) (4.1.4); RR = (1 - 0.5^sqrt(HR)) / (1 - 0.5^sqrt(1/HR)) (VanderWeele 2020)
quantities: E-value of the confidence limit closest to the null (one limit missing in hr3)

methods.name: sensemakr benchmark bounds, adjusted estimates and robustness values at alpha
methods.reference: sensemakr::sensemakr(lm, treatment, benchmark_covariates, kd, ky, q, alpha)$bounds (ovb_partial_r2_bound, adjusted_estimate, adjusted_se, adjusted_t with h0 = (1 - q) estimate, CI with qt(alpha/2, df)); sensemakr::robustness_value(t, dof, q, alpha); adjusted_estimate and adjusted_t on a grid (0.1.6)
quantities: RV_q and RV_alpha at five settings of kd, ky, q, alpha
benchmark bounds r2dz.x and r2yz.dx (female, age)
adjusted estimate, SE, t and CI
the clamp of an implied r2yz.dx above 1 (adjusted SE 0, t infinite)
contour grid of adjusted estimates and t-statistics
robustness_value on six inputs, one in the extreme branch
methods.tolerance: validation/README.md, n = 1276: coefficients 1e-10, SEs and statistics 1e-8; robustness_value inputs 1e-10 relative (closed form through a t quantile, see the test)

methods.name: Logit and probit marginal effects at the mean and average comparisons
methods.reference: stats::glm(binomial(logit | probit), epsilon = 1e-14) with the delta method: MEM SE with G = f(zbar) I + beta f'(zbar) xbar'; average comparisons mean(F(z2) - F(z1)) with gradient mean(f(z2) X2 - f(z1) X1); cross-checked in the case against marginaleffects::slopes(newdata = 'mean') and avg_comparisons
quantities: MEM, its SE, z and p (intercept included)
average comparisons of x1 over the pairs of 0, 1, 2.5: estimate, SE, p
methods.tolerance: iterative (GLM stopping rule): logit 1e-8, probit 1e-6 (Fisher scoring stops about 2e-7 from glm); p 1e-6 (logit) and 1e-4 (probit), z^2 times the z error with |z| <= 9
